about: A real RPKI repository archive read by tests/test_signed_object_corpus.py. Fetched by tools/fetch_corpus.py into a cache outside the repository; never vendored. Each pin is the file as served on the read date.

files.name: ripe-archive-afrinic-20261112-repo.tar.xz
files.kind: RPKI repository archive: everything Routinator fetched from the AFRINIC trust anchor on 2026-11-12, RRDP and rsync trees
files.why: the smallest daily archive of the five RIR trust anchors in the RIPE NCC RPKI repository archive (listing read 2026-11-13: afrinic 29M, lacnic 104M, apnic 170M, ripencc 242M, arin 539M); a published daily archive rather than one RRDP snapshot because it holds the whole tree under the TA, delegated CAs included, so chains can be built from it
files.terms: RIPE NCC RPKI repository archive, https://ftp.ripe.net/rpki/README.txt and https://github.com/RIPE-NCC/internet-dataset-descriptions/blob/main/rpki-repo-archive.md read 2026-11-13 (no licence stated there); RIPE NCC Website and Publicly Available RIPE NCC Services Terms of Service, https://www.ripe.net/about-us/legal/terms-of-service/, article 3.5 forbids re-distribution unless the service permits it. The objects are published by AFRINIC; AFRINIC's own RPKI terms were not read. Not vendored.

files.name: ripe-archive-afrinic-20261112-repo.tar.xz.sha256
files.kind: the archive operator's SHA-256 of repo.tar.xz, a second witness to the pin

files.name: ripe-archive-afrinic-20261112-output.json.xz
files.kind: Routinator's validated output for the same run: the VRPs a second implementation accepted from these objects
